theorem_title: Execution of one output-record digit split
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightOutputDecodeStep.meets {pMain pDivide : ℕ}
    (hmain : P[pMain]?=some (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightOutputDecodeStep.body pDivide))
    (hdivide : P[pDivide]?=some _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightOutputDecodeDivide.body)
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word) (hd : d+1 < lim.depth)
    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hx : x < T*M) (hxV : x ≤ V)
    (hmask : masks+M ≤ work) (hocc : outOcc < work) (hout : outMask < work)
    (hne : outOcc ≠ outMask) (hspace : _root_.ThreeSum.LightOutputDecodeStep.space work V ≤ lim.space)
    (hword : (_root_.ThreeSum.LightOutputDecodeStep.word V T M acc power U : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (hf : ∀ s < M, f s ≤ U) (hread : ∀ s < M, μ (masks+s)=(f s : ℤ)) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim P pMain d [x,T,M,masks,acc,power,outOcc,outMask,work] μ (_root_.ThreeSum.LightOutputDecodeStep.time V)
      (fun r ν => r=((acc+power*(x/M) : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
        ν outOcc=((x/M : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧ ν outMask=(f (x%M) : ℤ) ∧
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightOutputDecodeStep.KeptOthers μ ν work outOcc outMask) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $T,M\ge1$, $x<TM$, $x\le V$, accumulator $a$ and positional power $q$ be natural numbers. Let memory $\mu$ store a length-$M$ mask table $f(s)\le U$ at $b_m$. Let distinct occurrence and mask output cells lie below scratch $w$, with $b_m+M\le w$. Assume addresses fit words, the explicit scratch and word budgets fit, $d+1$ is strictly below the call limit, and $P$ contains the step and output-division bodies. The call returns

$$a+q\lfloor x/M\rfloor,$$

writes $\lfloor x/M\rfloor$ and $f(x\bmod M)$ to the two output cells, meets its stated time and preserves all other cells below $w$.

This recovers the original schedule occurrence and layer mask while accumulating the source occurrence code.
